name: Wide-Grip Neutral Pull-Up
instructions: Use a pull-up station with fixed parallel or angled neutral-grip handles spaced wider than shoulder width. Face your palms toward each other, or slightly toward you with semi-neutral handles.
Grip both handles and begin in a controlled hang with your torso steady. Pull yourself upward without swinging, using a comfortable range of motion.
Lower yourself under control and repeat for the repetitions you complete. Record zero added kg for bodyweight repetitions; record added weight separately when used.

This is the wide neutral/parallel-grip variation, distinct from a wide overhand pull-up and the close-grip V-bar pull-up. Use equipment intended for pull-ups rather than improvising an unsecured cable attachment.
photoNote: Reference photo: a standard neutral-grip V-bar pull-up. This variation uses wider fixed neutral handles; the reference photo does not show that wider spacing.
